original_hook: 📰 CoinDesk reported August Core CPI rose 0.3% above forecast, triggering macro rate fears, while Cointelegraph confirmed $449M in Bitcoin ETF outflows over three days. Source: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub Yet despite institutional redemptions, $BTC is coiling in a narrow 1.44% intraday range near $77,360. The mechanics: Spiking bond yields raise TradFi hurdle rates, forcing systematic portfolio models to redeem ETF shares. Issuers sell spot BTC into exchanges, but native spot buyers are absorbing the flow without capitulating. The risk. If real yields stay elevated, tactical rebalancing could become structural selling and erode spot support. Watch whether ETF flows stabilize before $77,000 breaks. Bullish, bearish, or wait?
